J11.basis: non-Worker ids refused with zero writes, one winner under concurrency (worker_accept_authority; service-independent RPC exercised on a plumbing fixture)

J12.name: payment_skip_edge
J12.basis: reviewed is written only by service-role functions; review requires paid (canonical_completion_payment_authority)

J14.name: payment_rail_and_callback
J14.basis: order opened for all six services, reconciliation exercised on electrical, plumbing and cleaning fixtures (service-independent code); manual-bank rail verified at T1 for all ten owner items; an order sent to reconciliation can be confirmed on the exact amount (F-PAY-1 fixed); F-PAY-2 (concurrent same-reference surfaces a raw unique violation) is open

J15.name: atomicity_rls_concurrency
J15.basis: unique (session, turn_index), per-actor RLS, no API write path, atomic refusal, concurrent confirmation and turn-index races (six_service_confirmation_gate + confirm-accept-concurrency)
